name: USGS SIM 3464 named map-label anchors
description: Display-only anchor points from USGS nomenclature text labels. They are not feature centroids or boundaries.

marsCoordinateSystem.note: Coordinates use Mars longitude and latitude; they are not Earth WGS 84 coordinates.
